title: Show active work in pipeline log
summary: Pipeline Log surfaces now prepend active-work evidence when close-readiness or diagnostics reports running work, even if the raw log tail is still from a previous run.
reason: Operators need immediate visible evidence that a CSV rerun or other pipeline work is active; showing only diagnostics.log_tail can make the log panel appear idle or stale.
behavior_before: The floating Pipeline Log and standalone log window rendered only /api/diagnostics log_tail, so old tail lines could be shown while close-readiness reported active work.
behavior_after: Both log surfaces read /api/backend/close-readiness alongside diagnostics and prepend an ACTIVE WORK DETECTED block with close reason and ActiveJobs/worker-progress evidence before the raw tail.
rollback_plan: Revert the changes in the two Pipeline Log WebView scripts plus the related static test and refreshed generated summaries.
notes:
Prepend active-work evidence to the floating pipeline log when close-readiness or diagnostics reports running work.
Mirror active-work evidence in the standalone read-only pipeline log window.
Cover close-readiness reads and active-work banner rendering in the pipeline log overlay smoke.
Refresh generated source summary after active-work log overlay change.
Refresh generated source summary after standalone log window change.
Refresh generated test summary for pipeline log static smoke coverage.
